title: Seasoned-Loan Multiplier on Home Purchase Financing Late Charges
content:
**Seasoning schedule — Home Purchase Financing late charges**

Where the loan's first installment fell due 60 or more whole months before the assessment date, the late seasoning multiplier is 0.9; where it fell due 36 to 59 whole months before, the late seasoning multiplier is 0.95. Where it fell due fewer than 36 whole months before, no seasoning multiplier applies.

The multiplier acts on the late charge figure before its single rounding to the cent, ahead of the program's floor and cap. The first installment's due date is the first payment date on the loan record.

| Whole months from the first installment's due date to the assessment date | Late seasoning multiplier |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 0.9 |
| 36 to 59 | 0.95 |
| fewer than 36 | none applies |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical assessment date 2026-03-20)

| First installment due | Whole months | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 2021-03-15 | 60 | 0.9 |
| 2021-04-15 | 59 | 0.95 |
| 2023-03-15 | 36 | 0.95 |
| 2023-04-15 | 35 | none |
